units.source_text: 对我来说，金阁绝不是一种观念，而是一种物体。

en.t: To me, the Golden Pavilion was by no means an idea, but a physical object.

units.source_text: 是一种尽管群山阻隔着我的眺望、但只要想看还是可以到那里去看的物体。

en.t: It was an object that, even though the mountains blocked my view of it, I could still go there and see whenever I wanted to.

units.source_text: 美就是这样一种手可以触摸、眼可以清晰地映现的物体。

en.t: Beauty was just such an object, something the hand could touch and the eye could clearly perceive.

units.source_text: 我知道并且相信：在纷繁变化的世界里，不变的金阁是千真万确的存在。

en.t: I knew and believed that, in a world of ceaseless change, the unchanging Golden Pavilion truly existed.
